Osijek Gornji Grad Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Osijek, Croatia

Not demolished. The larger of Osijek's two historic Jewish cemeteries, serving the Gornji grad congregation - once Croatia's biggest Jewish community, reaching 2,370 members by 1910 (see the Osijek Donji Grad Jewish Cemetery record for the full community history, including its complete destruction in the 1942 Holocaust deportations). Established in 1850, this cemetery remains in active use by Osijek's Jewish community today, holding roughly 500-600 to as many as 1,635 tombstones (estimates vary by source) that reflect the community's prewar prosperity, dated 1881 to 2018. Its neo-Romanesque ceremonial hall, in good condition, features a tiled central room with a floor Star of David and a matching star medallion above the chapel's central window.
